story.originalTitle: F1 2027: Season launch event to be held in Milan in February ahead of next campaign with teams, drivers present
story.summaryEn: F1 has announced that its 2027 season launch event, F1 The Show, will be held in Milan on February 18, featuring the 2027 drivers and teams.
detailZh: F1 2027：新赛季发布会将于明年2月在米兰举行，届时各车队和车手将悉数出席
在米兰举行的"F1 The Show"将汇集2027赛季的车手和车队，于2月18日启动新赛季；该活动将在这座意大利城市举办的为期三天的车迷节中进行，为下赛季造势
回顾2025年在伦敦O2体育馆举办的F1 75 LIVE上所有最有趣和最离奇的时刻
一级方程式将在明年2月于米兰举行其历史上第二次赛季启动活动，为2027赛季揭幕。
在2025年2月于伦敦The O2场馆举办F1 75 Live以纪念这项运动75周年之后，F1承诺两年后举办一场“规模更大、更具沉浸感”的活动，为新赛季拉开帷幕。
F1 Live Milan将包括一场为期三天的车迷节，于2月18日至20日在意大利城市举行。首晚的重头戏是F1 The Show，全部11支车队的车手和领队都将亮相，此外还有音乐和娱乐表演。

F1主席斯特凡诺·多梅尼卡利（Stefano Domenicali）表示：“我们始终志存高远、不断突破界限，F1 Live Milan将是一场以车迷为核心的非凡体验。”
“我们希望车迷感到自己不只是在观看这项运动，而是真正沉浸其中。这是我们持续雄心的重要部分，即让F1比以往任何时候都更贴近车迷，让他们有机会近距离见到自己的偶像，体验让F1如此独特的活力、创新与激情。”
“随着F1不断在世界各地吸引新的观众，赛车永远是我的灵魂——但我们也希望创造难忘的体验，以更大的规模将一级方程式的激情变为现实，并继续探索一切可能性。
“在伦敦F1 75取得非凡成功的基础上，F1 Live Milan将在为期三天难忘的时光里把米兰变成一场一级方程式盛会，让来自世界各地的人们聚在一起，庆祝他们热爱这项运动的一切。
“我知道我的意大利同胞们会热情欢迎前来参加F1 Live Milan的车迷，我迫不及待地想看到这座城市因一级方程式的活力而焕发生机，创造终生难忘的回忆。”
门票将于今年晚些时候开售，2月18日的发布活动将再次进行转播。

detailEn: F1 2027: Season launch event to be held in Milan in February ahead of next campaign with teams, drivers present
F1 The Show in Milan featuring the 2027 drivers and teams will launch the new season on February 18; event will form part of a three-day fan festival in Italian city to build up to next season
Take a look back at all the funniest and most bizarre moments from the F1 75 LIVE at The O2 in 2025
Formula 1 will stage its second-ever season launch event in Milan in February ahead of the 2027 campaign.

After holding F1 75 Live at London's The O2 in February 2025 to mark the start of the sport's 75th anniversary year, F1 are promising an "even bigger and more immersive" event two years on to kick off the next campaign.

F1 Live Milan will feature a three-day fan festival running in the Italian city from February 18-20. It will be headlined by F1 The Show on the first evening which will feature appearances from the drivers and principals of all 11 teams, in addition to music and entertainment acts.

F1 president Stefano Domenicali said: "We are always thinking big and pushing boundaries, and F1 Live Milan is going to be an incredible experience created with our fans at its heart.

"We want them to feel that they are not simply watching the sport, but they are truly immersed in it. It is an important part of our ongoing ambition to bring Formula 1 closer to fans than ever before, giving them the chance to see their heroes up close and experience the energy, innovation, and emotion that make Formula 1 so unique.

"As F1 continues to reach new audiences around the world, racing will always be our soul - but we also want to create unforgettable experiences that bring the excitement of Formula 1 to life on an even bigger scale and continue to explore what is possible.

"Building on the extraordinary success of F1 75 in London, F1 Live Milan will transform the city into a Formula 1 festival for three unforgettable days, bringing people together from across the globe to celebrate everything they love about our sport.

"I know my fellow Italians will offer a fantastic welcome to fans travelling to F1 Live Milan and I cannot wait to see the city come to life with Formula 1 energy, creating memories that will last a lifetime."
Tickets will go on sale later this year with the February 18 launch event to again be broadcast.
